metadata.description: Synthetic seed data for the Alarm Management API simulator. Not real plant data.

actions: Continue operation and monitor vibration trend for 24 hours
Schedule vibration analysis at next maintenance window
Reduce pump flow if suction pressure keeps falling
Check lube oil level and flow
Do not restart until cause is found
Inspect driven compressor for surge events
Check cooling fan and cooling water
Open recycle valve to reduce pressure
